international.title: Russell Brand’s wife vows to abide by prison rules after video controversy
international.summary: Laura Gallacher says in new video on YouTube she will continue Sunday Service series she started with Brand Laura Gallacher, Russell Brand’s wife, has promised to “absolutely honour” rules set by the prison where her convicted sex offender husband is being held, in another YouTube video published on Sunday. This week Andy Burnham called on Google to take down a video uploaded to Brand’s YouTube channel last Sunday that contained a statement from the disgraced comedian in prison, where he is serving a 10-and-a-half-year sentence for rape and sexual assaults.
